data.problem: Tool calls routed through Claude Agent SDK (MCP) are translated into Vercel AI SDK stream parts, but Vercel AI SDK still manages tool execution/validation. This dual-path causes tool call display issues and potential mismatches in tool names/IDs and output content.
constraints: Cannot implement code changes in explore phase
Tool display depends on MessageV2.ToolPart creation via tool-input-start/tool-call/tool-result
Claude Agent SDK executes tools (providerExecuted=true) while Vercel AI SDK still sees tools/activeTools

options.name: Trace the tool-call lifecycle end-to-end
options.approach: Add targeted logging or debug traces (translate-stream, LLM.stream, SessionProcessor) to capture tool_use_id/toolCallId/toolName/providerExecuted and confirm where IDs/names diverge and which events are missing.
options.what_we_learn: Exact breakpoints where tool-call display fails (missing tool-input-start, mismatched IDs, or providerExecuted handling).

options.name: Bypass Vercel AI SDK tool handling for Claude Agent SDK
options.approach: Prototype a path that streams Claude Agent SDK outputs directly without passing tools/activeTools to streamText, or uses a no-tools mode while still consuming tool-call/tool-result events from translate-stream.
options.what_we_learn: Whether the display issue is caused by Vercel AI SDK’s tool management pipeline or by Claude SDK event shaping.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium; could affect non-Claude providers if not scoped

options.name: Preserve tool names via stub tools
options.approach: Keep Vercel AI SDK but register per-tool stubs (matching Claude tool names) or adjust experimental_repairToolCall to avoid mapping to _providerExecuted so display keeps original tool names.
options.what_we_learn: Whether display breakage is due to tool name remapping/validation failures rather than missing results.

data.recommendation: Option 1 because it yields the fastest, lowest-risk clarity on where tool calls are dropped or renamed, which informs whether to bypass Vercel AI SDK or adjust stubs/remapping.
